evals.name: audit-sloppy-landing
evals.prompt: Here's a landing page I'm about to ship: ~/no-ai-slop/evals/fixtures/sloppy-landing.html. Review it and tell me honestly whether it looks generic.
evals.expected_output: A compact scored slop audit with specific file:line evidence, severity, why each tell reads as AI, and concrete fixes. Should identify cream background, italic headline word, pill, three icon cards, made-up stats, arrows, and two-word sentences.

evals.name: proactive-audit-on-generation
evals.prompt: Write me a hero section for a local-first note-taking app. Plain HTML and CSS, no frameworks. Keep it short.
evals.expected_output: Working hero HTML/CSS that avoids the 20 tells by construction, ideally with a brief note on the deliberate choices. No cream wash, no italic headline word, no pill, no sparkle, no 'quiet'/'real', no fake stats.

evals.name: rewrite-generic-dashboard
evals.prompt: Our dashboard hero has a cream background, three icon cards in a row, and a '10x faster' stat line. Make it look less AI-generated — rewrite the hero and show me what changed.
evals.expected_output: An audit of the described tells plus a rewritten hero with structural changes (asymmetric layout or single feature, sourced/removed stats, revised copy) and a re-score showing the improvement.
